findings.title: Missing Access Control on Campaign Creation
findings.description: The test code shows campaign creation without any ownership or permission checks visible. In a real scenario, this could allow anyone to create campaigns, potentially disrupting protocol operations or creating malicious campaigns.

findings.title: No Validation of Campaign Parameters
findings.description: The test shows creation of a campaign with tick range (-20, 100) but there's no indication the contract validates these parameters. Invalid tick ranges could lead to broken liquidity positions or fund loss.

findings.title: Potential Unsafe Token Handling
findings.description: The campaign uses POOL address as both liquidity token and token to send. Without seeing the actual token transfer logic, this could lead to reentrancy issues or improper token handling if not implemented correctly.

findings.title: Test Uses Hardcoded Values Without Boundary Checks
findings.description: The test uses fixed values like CAMPAIGN_ID and POS_ID as ZERO, which may not cover edge cases in actual deployment. This is a test design issue that might miss vulnerabilities in boundary conditions.

findings.title: Incomplete Code Analysis Due to Truncation
findings.description: The provided code is truncated at the function `lower_tick_out_`, preventing complete analysis of the test suite and potential vulnerabilities in the full implementation.
